hero.specialAbility: Whenever Leon wins a combat, add his winning card's boost value to the Treasure’s tracker. When you stop in a starting space on your turn, you may use Treasure’s to buy items from The Merchant.

ruleCards.content:
All shop cards start outside your deck. 
3 cost: Ammo restock - Draw 1 card
4 cost: Green herb - Heal 1 health
4 cost: Attaché Case - Add this card to your hand. 
6 cost: Tactical Vest - Add this card to your hand. 
6 cost: Red 9 Handgun - Add this card to your hand. 
8 cost: Rocket Launcher - Add this card to your hand.
ruleCards.title: The Merchant

note: Art is FINAL, self-hosted: all 15 card illustrations, the cardback and the hero token (a square crop of that cardback) are the final illustrations by the author (Grovelsey), hosted from the author's the-unmatched.club deck (hero 14131, export 2026-09-13) and mirrored into public/evergreen-decks/art/NQ5XP per the #446 self-hosting rule — wired as plain illustrations (imageUrl only, never cardImage) that the generated template draws inside the card frame. Titles frozen by the author after the lab playtest (2026-09-13): HandCannon became LE5 - submachine Gun (2/1, UNLOAD! second attack) and Shop - Red 9 Handgun became Shop - BlackTail Handgun. Verbatim titles (shop - rocket Launcher, Shop - Tactical vest, Shop - BlackTail Handgun, Shop - Attache case, Staggering shot, LE5 - submachine Gun) are the print the engine carries — do not fix.
